_doc: R14 music source manifest: one row per generated track. gen_music.py renders each row with ACE-Step 1.5 on the local ComfyUI (AceMusic nodes), make_loop.py cuts a bar-aligned loop (Trim*, Bars) and writes Content/DC/Audio/Source/<Id>.wav. The game reads the imported S_Music_<Id> assets through Music= / +MusicTracks in Config/DefaultGame.ini; this file is a tool input only.
